name: Adversary
description: Upgrades the difficulty of combat checks targeting the character once per rank.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 142

name: All-Terrain Driver
description: Ignores difficult-terrain driving penalties while piloting with Piloting (Planetary).
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 142

name: Anatomy Lessons
description: After a successful personal-weapon attack, spend a Destiny Point to add Intellect to one hit's damage.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 142

name: Armor Master
description: While wearing armor, increases total soak by 1.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 142

name: Armor Master (Improved)
description: While wearing armor with soak 2 or more, increases defense by 1.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 143

name: Bacta Specialist
description: Patients under the character's supervision heal 1 additional wound per rank during bacta, supervised care, or long-term care.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 143

name: Bad Motivator
description: Once per session, a successful Hard Mechanics check causes a GM-approved device to fail.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 143

name: Balance
description: After recovering strain at an encounter's end, roll Force dice and recover additional strain from light-side results.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 143

name: Basic Combat Training
description: Makes Brawl and Ranged (Light) career skills.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 143

name: Blooded
description: Adds a boost per rank when resisting or recovering from toxins and shortens their ongoing effects by 1 round per rank.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 143

name: Body Guard
description: Once per round, protect an engaged ally by taking up to the talent's ranks in strain to upgrade attacks against that ally equally until the next turn.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 143

name: Bought Info
description: Pays 50 credits per check difficulty to count as succeeding at a Knowledge check with one success when information can be bought.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 143

name: Brace
description: Removes a setback per rank from the next check hindered by disruptive physical conditions.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 143

name: Brilliant Evasion
description: Once per encounter, win an opposed Piloting check to prevent one opposing vehicle or starship from attacking the character's vehicle for Agility rounds.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 144

name: Bypass Security
description: Removes a setback per rank from Computers and Skulduggery checks to defeat security or locks.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 144

name: Careful Planning
description: Once per session, introduces a reasonable narrative fact or context as though spending a Destiny Point.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 144

name: Clever Solution
description: Once per session, makes one skill check with Cunning instead of its linked characteristic when the player explains the approach.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 144

name: Codebreaker
description: Removes a setback per rank from codebreaking or decryption attempts and lowers the relevant Computers or Intellect check difficulty by 1.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 144

name: Command
description: Adds a boost per rank to Leadership and similar leadership checks; inspired targets gain the same boost on Discipline checks for 24 hours.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 144

name: Commanding Presence
description: Removes a setback per rank from Leadership and Cool checks.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 144

name: Confidence
description: Lowers fear-avoidance Discipline check difficulty by 1 per rank, eliminating the check at zero difficulty.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 144

name: Contraption
description: Once per session, a successful Hard Mechanics check improvises a GM-approved device for the current encounter from tools that are consumed.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 144

name: Convincing Demeanor
description: Removes a setback per rank from Deception and Skulduggery checks.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 145

name: Coordinated Assault
description: Engaged allies up to the character's Leadership ranks gain a boost on combat checks until the next turn; range increases per rank.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 145

name: Creative Killer
description: Reduces the critical rating of wielded improvised weapons by 2, to a minimum of 1.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 145

name: Crippling Blow
description: Voluntarily increases a combat check's difficulty by 1; if it damages wounds, the target suffers strain whenever it moves for the encounter.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 145

name: Dead to Rights
description: Spend a Destiny Point after a successful vehicle- or ship-mounted weapon attack to add half Agility, rounded up, to one hit's damage.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 145

name: Dead to Rights (Improved)
description: Replaces Dead to Rights by spending a Destiny Point to add full Agility to one hit from a successful vehicle- or ship-mounted weapon attack.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 145

name: Deadly Accuracy
description: For each rank, choose a different combat skill and add its basic-training ranks to one hit from a successful personal-weapon attack with that skill.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 145

name: Debilitating Shot
description: After a successful vehicle or starship weapon attack, spend two Advantage to lower the target's maximum speed by 1 through the next round.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 145

name: Dedication
description: Permanently increases one chosen characteristic by 1 per rank, up to 6.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 145

name: Defensive Driving
description: Raises every defense zone of a vehicle the character pilots by 1 per rank.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 145

name: Defensive Slicing
description: Adds a setback per rank to attempts to intrude on a defended computer system or one the character owns or programmed.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 145

name: Defensive Slicing (Improved)
description: When defending a system from intrusion, upgrades an opponent's difficulty once per rank of Defensive Slicing instead of its normal benefit.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 145

name: Defensive Stance
description: Once per round, take up to the talent's ranks in strain to upgrade incoming melee attacks equally until the next turn.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 146

name: Disorient
description: After a combat hit, spend the required Advantage to disorient the target for rounds equal to the talent's ranks.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 146

name: Dodge
description: When targeted by combat, immediately suffer strain up to ranks in Dodge to upgrade the attack difficulty equally.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 146

name: Durable
description: Reduces Critical Injury results suffered by 10 per rank, to a minimum of 1.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 146

name: Dynamic Fire
description: While making a ranged attack when engaged, suffer 2 strain to reduce its engaged-range difficulty modifier by 1.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 146

name: Enduring
description: Increases soak by 1 per rank.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 146

name: Exhaust Port
description: Before attacking a starship or vehicle, spend a Destiny Point to ignore the Massive rule for that attack.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 146

name: Expert Tracker
description: Removes a setback per rank from tracking checks and halves Survival tracking time.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 146

name: Familiar Suns
description: Once per session, a successful Hard Knowledge (Core Worlds or Outer Rim) check reveals useful facts about the current planet's environment and habitation.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 146

name: Feral Strength
description: Adds 1 damage per rank to one hit from successful Brawl and Melee attacks.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 146

name: Field Commander
description: With a successful Average Leadership check, allies up to Presence may each take 1 strain to perform a free maneuver.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 146

name: Field Commander (Improved)
description: Doubles Field Commander's affected allies and lets Advantage on its check allow an ally to take 1 strain for an action instead of a maneuver.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 146

name: Fine Tuning
description: Repairs 1 additional system strain per rank when repairing system strain on a vehicle or starship.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 147

name: Fire Control
description: In a vehicle or starship, treats targets as 1 silhouette larger for its combat checks until the next turn; this does not stack.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 147

name: Forager
description: Removes up to two setback dice from checks to find food, water, or shelter and halves foraging time.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 147

name: Force of Will
description: Once per session, makes one skill check with Willpower instead of its linked characteristic when the player explains the approach.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 147

name: Force Rating
description: Permanently increases Force rating by 1 per rank.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 147

name: Form on Me
description: When using Gain the Advantage, nearby allied vehicles up to the character's Leadership ranks also gain its benefits while they remain close.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 147

name: Frenzied Attack
description: On a Brawl or Melee check, suffer strain up to ranks in Frenzied Attack to upgrade the check's ability equally.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 147

name: Full Stop
description: Immediately reduces a piloted vehicle or starship's speed to 0 and inflicts system strain equal to its former speed.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 147

name: Full Throttle
description: Makes a Hard Piloting check to raise a vehicle or ship's top speed by 1 for Cunning rounds.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 147

name: Full Throttle (Improved)
description: Suffer 1 strain to attempt Full Throttle as a maneuver, with its difficulty reduced to Average.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 148

name: Full Throttle (Supreme)
description: A successful Full Throttle raises top speed by 2, rather than 1, for Cunning rounds.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 148

name: Galaxy Mapper
description: Removes a setback per rank from Astrogation checks and halves Astrogation time.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 148

name: Gearhead
description: Removes a setback per rank from Mechanics checks and halves attachment-modification credit costs.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 148

name: Greased Palms
description: Before a social check, spend up to 50 credits per rank to upgrade the check's ability once per 50 credits.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 148

name: Grit
description: Increases strain threshold by 1 per rank.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 148

name: Hard Headed
description: While staggered or disoriented, make a Daunting Discipline check to end those conditions; difficulty drops per additional rank.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 148

name: Hard Headed (Improved)
description: Uses Hard Headed after strain incapacitation to attempt a Formidable Discipline check and reduce strain to 1 below threshold on success.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 148

name: Heightened Awareness
description: Allies within short range gain a boost to Perception and Vigilance checks; engaged allies gain two boosts instead.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 148

name: Heroic Fortitude
description: Spend a Destiny Point to ignore ongoing Critical Injury effects on Brawn- or Agility-based checks until encounter end.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 148

name: Hidden Storage
description: Gives owned large equipment, vehicles, or droids concealed compartments up to total encumbrance equal to ranks in Hidden Storage.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 148

name: Hold Together
description: Spend a Destiny Point after a repaired vehicle or starship takes hull trauma this encounter to convert that attack's damage to system strain.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 149

name: Incite Rebellion
description: Once per session, a successful Hard Coercion check makes beings up to Coercion ranks act against an authority over them for the encounter.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 149

name: Indistinguishable
description: Upgrades checks to identify the character once per rank.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 149

name: Insight
description: Makes Perception and Discipline career skills.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 149

name: Inspiring Rhetoric
description: With an Average Leadership check, allies within close range recover strain; Advantage can recover additional strain.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 149

name: Inspiring Rhetoric (Improved)
description: Allies affected by Inspiring Rhetoric gain a boost to skill checks for Leadership ranks in rounds; it does not stack.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 149

name: Inspiring Rhetoric (Supreme)
description: Suffer 1 strain to use Inspiring Rhetoric as a maneuver instead of an action.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 149

name: Intense Focus
description: Before a skill check, suffer 1 strain to upgrade its ability once.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 150

name: Intense Presence
description: Spend a Destiny Point to recover strain equal to Presence.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 150

name: Intimidating
description: Suffer strain up to ranks in Intimidating to downgrade difficulty on a Coercion check or upgrade a Coercion check targeting the character.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 150

name: Inventor
description: When making or modifying gear, adds a boost or removes a setback from the check per rank.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 150

name: Invigorate
description: Once per encounter, when a nearby ally makes a Brawn- or Agility-based skill check, roll a Force die to add a boost from light or setback from dark results.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 150

name: It's Not That Bad
description: Once per session before an ally takes a Critical Injury, make a Hard Medicine check to prevent that injury on success.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 150

name: Jump Up
description: Once per round, stand from prone or seated as an incidental.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 150

name: Jury Rigged
description: Per rank, improves one personal weapon or armor in a selected permitted way, such as damage, critical cost, defense, or encumbrance.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 150

name: Kill with Kindness
description: Removes a setback per rank from Charm and Leadership checks.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 150

name: Knockdown
description: After a melee hit, spend the required Advantage to knock the target prone, with an extra cost for each larger silhouette.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 150

name: Know Somebody
description: Once per session when buying a legally available item, lowers its rarity by 1 per rank.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 150

name: Knowledge Specialization
description: Choose a Knowledge skill when acquiring the talent; spend Advantage on that skill to gain successes equal to ranks in Knowledge Specialization.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 150

name: Known Schematic
description: Once per session, a successful Hard Knowledge (Education) check reveals useful layout and component information for a building or capital ship.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 151

name: Let's Ride
description: Once per round, mount, dismount, or enter or leave a vehicle, beast, or starship station as an incidental.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 151

name: Lethal Blows
description: Adds 10 per rank to Critical Injury rolls inflicted on opponents.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 151

name: Master Doctor
description: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to lower the next Medicine check's difficulty by 1, to a minimum of Easy.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 151

name: Master Driver
description: Once per round while using Piloting (Planetary), suffer 2 strain to perform an action as a maneuver.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 151

name: Master Grenadier
description: Lowers the Advantage cost to activate a weapon's Blast quality by 1, to a minimum of 1, including when it misses.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 151

name: Master Leader
description: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to lower the next Leadership check's difficulty by 1, to a minimum of Easy.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 151

name: Master Merchant
description: Before buying or selling, suffer 2 strain; on a successful check, sell for 25% more or buy for 25% less.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 151

name: Master of Shadows
description: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to lower the next Stealth or Skulduggery check's difficulty by 1, to a minimum of Easy.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 151

name: Master Pilot
description: Once per round while piloting a starship, suffer 2 strain to perform an action as a maneuver.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 151

name: Master Slicer
description: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to lower the next Computers or slicing-related check's difficulty by 1, to a minimum of Easy.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 151

name: Master Starhopper
description: Once per round, suffer 2 strain to lower the next Astrogation check's difficulty by 1, to a minimum of Easy.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 151

name: Mental Fortress
description: Spend a Destiny Point to ignore ongoing Critical Injury effects on Intellect- or Cunning-based checks until encounter end.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 151

name: Natural Brawler
description: Once per session, rerolls one Brawl or Melee check.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 153

name: Natural Charmer
description: Once per session, rerolls one Charm or Deception check.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 153

name: Natural Doctor
description: Once per session, rerolls one Medicine check.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 153

name: Natural Driver
description: Once per session, rerolls one Piloting (Planetary) or Gunnery check.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 153

name: Natural Enforcer
description: Once per session, rerolls one Coercion or Streetwise check.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 153

name: Natural Hunter
description: Once per session, rerolls one Perception or Vigilance check.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 153

name: Natural Leader
description: Once per session, rerolls one Cool or Leadership check.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 153

name: Natural Marksman
description: Once per session, rerolls one Ranged (Light) or Ranged (Heavy) check.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 153

name: Natural Negotiator
description: Once per session, rerolls one Cool or Negotiation check.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 153

name: Natural Outdoorsman
description: Once per session, rerolls one Resilience or Survival check.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 153

name: Natural Pilot
description: Once per session, rerolls one Piloting (Space) or Gunnery check.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 153

name: Natural Programmer
description: Once per session, rerolls one Computers or Astrogation check.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 153

name: Natural Rogue
description: Once per session, rerolls one Skulduggery or Stealth check.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 153

name: Natural Scholar
description: Once per session, rerolls one Knowledge skill check.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 153

name: Natural Tinkerer
description: Once per session, rerolls one Mechanics check.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 153

name: Nobody's Fool
description: Upgrades the difficulty of Charm, Coercion, and Deception checks targeting the character once per rank.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 153

name: Outdoorsman
description: Removes a setback per rank from terrain or environmental movement checks and halves overland travel time.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 154

name: Overwhelm Defenses
description: After an unsuccessful vehicle or starship weapon attack, spend the required Advantage per rank to reduce the targeted defense zone for the encounter.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 154

name: Physical Training
description: Adds a boost per rank to Athletics and Resilience checks.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 154

name: Plausible Deniability
description: Removes a setback per rank from Coercion and Deception checks.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 154

name: Point Blank
description: Adds 1 damage per rank to one hit from successful Ranged (Heavy) or Ranged (Light) attacks at short or engaged range.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 154

name: Powerful Blast
description: Increases Blast damage from explosives, explosive weapons, and grenades by 1 per rank.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 154

name: Quick Draw
description: Once per round, draws or holsters an accessible item as an incidental and shortens longer weapon preparation or stowing by 1 maneuver.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 154

name: Quick Fix
description: Once per session, makes one skill check with Agility instead of its linked characteristic when the player explains the approach.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 154

name: Quick Strike
description: Adds a boost per rank to combat checks against targets that have not acted in the encounter.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 154

name: Rapid Reaction
description: Suffers strain up to ranks in Rapid Reaction to add equal successes to a Vigilance or Cool initiative check.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 154

name: Rapid Recovery
description: Recovers 1 additional strain per rank after an encounter.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 154

name: Redundant Systems
description: Once per session, a successful Easy Mechanics check harvests compatible components to repair a broken device without consuming the donor.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 154

name: Researcher
description: Removes a setback per rank from Knowledge checks and halves research time.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 154

name: Resolve
description: When suffering strain, reduces it by 1 per rank to a minimum of 1, excluding voluntary strain.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 155

name: Respected Scholar
description: Downgrades the difficulty of checks to interact with institutions of learning by 1 per rank.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 155

name: Scathing Tirade
description: With an Average Coercion check, enemies within short range suffer strain; Advantage can inflict additional strain on affected targets.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 155

name: Scathing Tirade (Improved)
description: Enemies affected by Scathing Tirade suffer a setback on skill checks for Coercion ranks in rounds; it does not stack.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 155

name: Scathing Tirade (Supreme)
description: Suffer 1 strain to use Scathing Tirade as a maneuver instead of an action.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 155

name: Second Wind
description: Once per encounter, recovers strain equal to ranks in Second Wind.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 155

name: Selective Detonation
description: Spend Advantage when using Blast or explosives to exclude targets, up to ranks in Selective Detonation.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 155

name: Sense Danger
description: Once per session, removes two setback dice from one skill check.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 155

name: Shortcut
description: During a chase, adds a boost per rank to checks to catch or escape an opponent.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 155

name: Side Step
description: Once per round, take up to the talent's ranks in strain to upgrade incoming ranged attacks equally until the next turn.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 156

name: Situational Awareness
description: In a vehicle or starship with working communications, nearby allies gain boosts to Perception and Vigilance checks on planetary scale.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 156

name: Sixth Sense
description: Gains 1 ranged defense.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 156

name: Skilled Jockey
description: Removes a setback per rank from Piloting (Planetary) and Piloting (Space) checks.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 156

name: Skilled Slicer
description: On a Computers check, spend Advantage to gain control of part of the target system and make later Computers checks there as maneuvers.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 156

name: Sleight of Mind
description: Adds a boost per rank to Stealth checks unless the observer is immune to Force powers.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 156

name: Smooth Talker
description: Choose Charm, Coercion, Negotiation, or Deception when acquired; spend Advantage on it to gain successes equal to ranks in Smooth Talker.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 156

name: Sniper Shot
description: Before a non-thrown ranged attack, extends maximum range by 1 band per rank while upgrading difficulty beyond the weapon's normal maximum.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 156

name: Soft Spot
description: After a successful personal-weapon attack, spend a Destiny Point to add Cunning to one hit's damage.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 156

name: Solid Repairs
description: Repairs 1 additional hull trauma per rank when repairing a vehicle or starship.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 156

name: Sound Investments
description: At the start of each session, gains credits equal to 100 times ranks in Sound Investments, subject to GM availability.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 156

name: Spare Clip
description: Does not run out of ammunition on a Despair; Limited Ammo still runs out normally.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 157

name: Speaks Binary
description: Grants a boost per rank to tasks directed for non-player-character droids.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 157

name: Stalker
description: Adds a boost per rank to Coordination and Stealth checks.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 157

name: Steely Nerves
description: Spend a Destiny Point to ignore ongoing Critical Injury effects on Presence- or Willpower-related checks until encounter end.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 157

name: Stim Application
description: With an Average Medicine check and medical supplies, temporarily raises one chosen characteristic of an engaged ally by 1 and inflicts 4 strain.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 157

name: Stim Application (Improved)
description: When using Stim Application, raise its Medicine check to Hard so the target suffers 1 strain instead of 4.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 157

name: Stim Application (Supreme)
description: When using Stim Application, each spent Triumph can raise an additional characteristic by 1.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 157

name: Stimpack Specialization
description: Stimpacks heal 1 additional wound per rank; the sixth and later daily stimpack still has no effect.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 157

name: Street Smarts
description: Removes a setback per rank from Streetwise and Knowledge (Underworld) checks.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 157

name: Stroke of Genius
description: Once per session, makes one skill check with Intellect instead of its linked characteristic when the player explains the approach.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 157

name: Strong Arm
description: Treats thrown weapons as having 1 greater range band, up to medium.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 157

name: Stunning Blow
description: When making a Melee check, may deal strain instead of wounds without ignoring soak.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 157

name: Stunning Blow (Improved)
description: When dealing strain with Melee or Brawl, spend the required Advantage to stagger the target for 1 round per Advantage spent.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 157

name: Superior Reflexes
description: Gains 1 melee defense.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 157

name: Surgeon
description: Medicine checks that heal wounds restore 1 additional wound per rank.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 158

name: Swift
description: Moves through difficult terrain without its movement penalties.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 158

name: Tactical Combat Training
description: Makes Melee and Ranged (Heavy) career skills.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 158

name: Targeted Blow
description: On a successful personal-weapon attack, spend a Destiny Point to add Agility to one hit's damage.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 158

name: Technical Aptitude
description: Reduces time needed for computer-related tasks by 25% per rank.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 158

name: Time to Go
description: Spend a Destiny Point after determining a blast would hit to make an out-of-turn Move maneuver before damage is applied.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 158

name: Time to Go (Improved)
description: When using Time to Go, lets one engaged ally also make that out-of-turn Move maneuver.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 158

name: Tinkerer
description: Per rank, gives one selected piece of equipment 1 additional hard point; replacements may be selected if the item is lost.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 158

name: Touch of Fate
description: Once per session, adds two boost dice to one skill check.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 158

name: Toughened
description: Increases wound threshold by 2 per rank.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 158

name: Tricky Target
description: A vehicle the character pilots counts as 1 silhouette smaller when attacked, to a minimum of 0.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 158

name: True Aim
description: Once per round before a ranged attack, gains normal aiming benefits and upgrades the attack once per rank.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 158

name: Uncanny Reactions
description: Adds a boost per rank to Vigilance checks.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 158

name: Uncanny Senses
description: Adds a boost per rank to Perception checks.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 158

name: Unstoppable
description: Prevents a Critical Injury when its percentile result is or is reduced to 1.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 159

name: Utility Belt
description: Spend a Destiny Point to produce an essential, previously undocumented small tool of rarity 4 or less; it is not normally a weapon.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 159

name: Vehicle Combat Training
description: Makes Gunnery and Piloting (Planetary) career skills.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 159

name: Well Rounded
description: Selects any two skills that permanently become career skills.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 159

name: Well Traveled
description: Makes Knowledge (Core Worlds) and Knowledge (Outer Rim) career skills.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 159

name: Wheel and Deal
description: When selling legal goods to a reputable merchant, gains 10% more credits per rank from the original sale price.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 159

name: Works Like a Charm
description: Once per session, makes one skill check with Presence instead of its linked characteristic when the player explains the approach.
source: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook, p. 159
